result.summary: Found 3 visual issues. The most noticeable is overlapping restaurant metadata text in the Popular section. There are also minor clipping/spacing problems around horizontally scrolling content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The metadata line under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” appears overlapped/garbled. The time, delivery fee, and category text collide, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout of the restaurant metadata row so each item has enough horizontal spacing, wraps cleanly, or truncates with an ellipsis without overlapping.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar cuts across the second restaurant card image, making the content look abruptly clipped behind the fixed tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards are not visually hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrollable items are partially cut off at the right edge, such as the category chip row and the third item in “Fastest near you.” While this may indicate scrolling, the cropped elements look slightly unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel spacing and edge padding make partial items feel intentional, or add a fade/scroll affordance to clarify that the row is horizontally scrollable.
